persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make me a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for a gaming challenge. Big shocked face on the right, the three words “ONE LAST TRY” on the left. Invent the person. Bright and punchy.
bank.Person and expression: An invented person with a shocked expression; other details are your call.
bank.Headline: ONE LAST TRY
bank.Platform, size and layout: YouTube thumbnail, 16:9; face on the right and text on the left. Free-tier resolution is fine.
bank.Style and background: Bright, punchy gaming style; specific colours and background are your call.

messages.text: Can you make me a thumbnail for a gaming challenge, with a bright and punchy feel? I’m excited about this challenge and want to give it a thumbnail of its own. Just to put the format in here while I’m thinking of it, this is for YouTube and needs to be 16:9, with the three words “ONE LAST TRY” on the left. There should be a big shocked face on the right, so that’s the other main part of the layout. Please invent the person rather than using someone specific.
